jobs.title: Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering (Head of PC Game Security) - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls.   • Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
  • Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio

jobs.title: Senior VFX Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you’ll design and help implement the sleek, dynamic and dramatic special effects that add atmosphere and depth to gameplay. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically astounding visual effects that communicate essential game information. You’ll use your artistic and technical skills to breathe life into undead spells, channel primal emotions and capture the essence of hundreds of champions.

As a Senior VFX Artist on the Riot Discovery Studio (RDS) team, you will report to the Sr. VFX Manager and play a key role on a small VFX team delivering high-spectacle gameplay experiences. Under the direction of the VFX Lead, you will use your creative and technical expertise to design, execute, and implement a wide range of gameplay and environmental visual effects. You’ll partner closely with VFX, Design, and other disciplines to establish best practices, champion visual quality and gameplay clarity, and translate your expertise into scalable solutions as the team transitions into production. Beyond asset creation, you will help strengthen the VFX discipline by sharing craft expertise, leading discipline initiatives, and serving as a bridge between VFX and cross-functional partners. You will also support team leadership with operational and discipline-development efforts that help the team work effectively and sustainably. RDS operates in a highly iterative environment, so you’ll need to navigate ambiguity and respond thoughtfully to frequent shifts in content, creative direction, and priorities. As the team continues to define its VFX direction and production practices, your work and expertise will directly influence the quality bar and help establish what great VFX looks like for the product.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver polished, dynamic visual effects that enhance atmosphere, depth, and gameplay while aligning with the project’s creative and stylistic goals.
  • Balance visual impact with gameplay clarity, ensuring effects accurately communicate actions, states, and player-facing information.
  • Autonomously create high-quality VFX by applying a broad range of craft skills, including painting, drawing, animation, and modeling as needed.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Our mission on the Developer Platform team is to help game studios succeed by creating meaningful experiences for players. In a given week, you might be prototyping an in-game invite flow, playtesting a mobile surface with your engineering partners, and walking the squad through your design rationale in a review. You'll bring a thoughtful mix of user empathy, systems thinking, and visual craft to solve meaningful problems for developers and players alike. If you're energized by complex challenges, passionate about games and community, and excited to help shape how studios partner with Discord, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Own and evolve core observability platforms, leading migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth
  • Build instrumentation libraries, SDKs, and eBPF-based auto-instrumentation to emit high-quality telemetry, with and without code changes
  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution by building cross-signal correlation (from kernel-level events up to application traces), unified query interfaces, and AI-assisted diagnostic tooling
  • Improve fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets
  • Partner with Research, Inference, Product, and Infrastructure teams to ensure observability solutions meet the unique needs of each organization

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Creative Direction - TFT
jobs.description:
Game Creative Directors at Riot define and oversee the overall creative strategy for a product. You’ll create inspiring creative direction across experiences that genuinely surprise and delight players. You will help build the product strategy and tie the product’s goals to the target audience. Creative direction is for the team; as the Creative Director acts as the intersection between aesthetics, story, and brand that evokes a visceral response in players. At that intersection you’ll lead with vision and demonstrate incredible taste with a high quality bar.

As a Senior Creative Director, you will be front and center in defining the creative direction of Teamfight Tactics, the world’s largest strategy game. In this role you will help lead a passionate, multi-discipline development team to own the Autobattler genre on PC and mobile by hyper-serving Teamfight Tactics players globally. Game Creative Directors are the most senior creative team leaders who define, communicate, align and maintain the overall creative direction of a product. Game Creative Directors will drive a holistic vision across all aspects of a game, working with every discipline and team to bring that creative vision to life. Game Creative Directors will manage the careers of developers and leaders from many creative crafts (art, audio, narrative, and technical art). You will be fostering a creative culture that focuses on players and delivering quality content.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a creative partner to the Executive Producer (EP) and Game Director, ensuring alignment and parity with product strategy and creative direction.
  • Define, maintain, and communicate the creative vision for Teamfight Tactics in support of the overall game vision.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise AI

Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential by building secure, reliable, and scalable internal systems that keep the company running smoothly.

As a Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in AI, you will personally design and build the AI agent capabilities and product experiences for an internal enterprise intelligence platform. You will consume and help shape requirements for that layer rather than building it yourself. Your work will directly improve how Rioters hire, plan, spend, onboard, and operate at scale.

The ideal candidate is a deeply experienced full-stack software engineer who has personally shipped AI-enabled products at scale, is comfortable building in ambiguous and evolving problem spaces, and takes ownership of systems from the first commit through production operation.

  • Integrate agents with internal and external tools/APIs (function/tool calling) to let them take real actions, not just answer questions.

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

  • 有完整游戏项目上线经验

对于这个岗位，你将通过工艺专业知识、协作精神以及优先考虑玩家乐趣的决策来获得成功。我们将关注您过去的学习、经验以及您与游戏的个人关系。如果您体现了玩家的同理心并关心玩家的体验，这可能就是您的角色！

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Senior Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will build and own major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

The hard problems in rapidly scaling heterogeneous GPU fleets are software problems: fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes. We solve them by building global and in-DC services, Kubernetes operators, and high-performance SDN libraries, forking hypervisors and Linux kernels, and building infra tailored to inference and fine-tuning. You'll own massive greenfield projects across their full lifecycle – scoping the problem and writing PRDs with our PMs, designing the system, and building it through to GA launch.

Responsibilities

  • Build the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that makes GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Build and maintain our in-DC IaaS layer: the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers, including VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions. Implement and harden the bring-up path for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs.
  • Scale the distributed GPU scheduling and global management plane: the control-plane services behind on-demand and reserved clusters, including the automation that onboards new capacity and raises per-cluster limits.
  • Harden the monitoring and automated remediation layer for fault tolerance: automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference fault-tolerant.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Tools Programmer to evolve artist tools within the Unreal Editor, particularly in geometry and texturing processing, terrain authoring, and procedural generation. An important aspect of this role is supporting both user-driven and agentic workflows, including exploring and implementing new interaction paradigms to accelerate content creation. You'll directly impact artist productivity by developing user-facing tools for one of the leading game engines used by developers worldwide.

In this role, you will

  • Support and extend existing artist tools for internal and external users
  • Refactor existing tools to be more accessible and effective for agentic workflows
  • Create new tools at the intersection of user-driven and agent-driven content creation
  • Collaborate with artists on internal projects and productions
  • Work with other developers across team boundaries on shared initiatives
  • Contribute to major initiatives that shape the future of the Unreal Editor

  • Excellent C++ skills
  • Strong background in developing artist tools within the games or film industry
  • Experience with geometry processing, texture processing, or procedural generation
  • Fluency in using current agentic tools and workflows for programming tasks
  • Track record of exploring and applying AI capabilities to advance artist workflows
  • Experience developing in a large codebase
  • Ability to work independently and deliver effectively as part of a distributed team
  • Experience working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes across teams

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a senior Tools Programmer to help build the next generation of UI tooling for users and AI-powered agentic workflows (tools that let AI agents assist with and automate UI creation, iteration, and debugging). You'll shape the systems and frameworks that millions of creators rely on, from WYSIWYG editors to the APIs and runtime UI capabilities used to ship games and tools.

In this role, you will

  • Design, build, and integrate AI-powered tools and frameworks for UI authoring, iteration, and debugging
  • Own and evolve the UI tech codebase used to build tools and in-game UI in Unreal Engine
  • Set technical direction for UI tooling and mentor other programmers
  • Collaborate across disciplines to identify improvement areas, gather feedback, and design solutions for developer needs
  • Profile and resolve performance and memory issues in UI systems
  • Work with Epic's internal teams and Unreal Engine licensees to help them solve UI challenges

What we're looking for

  • Strong tools-programming background with experience building tools that improve development workflows in games or other fields
  • Deep expertise in the UI domain (UI frameworks, runtime UI engines, and editor/WYSIWYG tooling)
  • Excellent C++ skills and experience working in a large codebase
  • Some hands-on exposure to AI-powered or agentic workflows, whether through work, courses, or personal projects
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience with Unreal Engine is a plus
  • Experience with Slate and/or UMG is a plus
  • Shipped title experience in games or real-time applications is a plus

This role is open to multiple locations in North America (including CA, NYC, & WA).

jobs.title: Staff + Software Security Engineer, Labs
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Frontier AI is on track to be among the most consequential and most adversarially-targeted technology in the world. The capability curve is steep, the adversaries who want these systems are extremely well-resourced, and the security bar this will eventually require is well beyond where the industry operates today. Incremental hardening alone is not going to close that gap, so we need breakthroughs and a group of people to go find them.

Security Labs is that team. We run a portfolio of high-risk, high-expected-value security projects: the work that seems impractical until someone optimistic and stubborn enough actually tries it. Projects run on the order of weeks rather than quarters, and each one is either handed off to the Anthropic team that will own it in production or wound down with a writeup of what we learned. We expect a meaningful fraction of our bets not to land.

This team is intentionally scrappy and ambitious. We're intentionally iterating fast on high-risk research bets and we expect a meaningful fraction not to land. If a 30% project success rate sounds uncomfortable, or uncharted and chaotic territory isn’t both frightening and exciting, this probably isn't the right fit. There are other places in Anthropic Security doing important work with more structure, less risk, and more certain paths to positive outcomes.

The questions we're trying to answer include:

  • Can our core research workflows survive extreme isolation?
  • Can we replace trust with cryptographic guarantees?
  • Can the models themselves become our most effective security control?
  • What would it actually take to defend against a tier-1 state adversary, and how much of that can we build now?

Who we're looking for. We're hiring generalists with rare depth. You're a strong software engineer as a baseline, and on top of that you've gone deep in at least one area most engineers don't get near: firmware or hardware security, applied cryptography, OS / kernel / hypervisor internals, formal methods, reverse engineering, or high-assurance and cross-domain systems. You've built things under your own direction, you're comfortable jumping layers when the problem demands it, and you'd rather take a swing at something that might not work than ship the safe incremental thing. You think the trajectory of AI matters a great deal, you're not comfortable with how the security side of it is going by default, and you'd rather be on the inside building the answer than watching from outsi

REMOTE IN INDIA

We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency. The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin-packing, right-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.

  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.

jobs.title: Director, Technical Accounting – Investments
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Director, Technical Accounting – Investments and M&A to join our Finance team at Anthropic. In this role, you will own the company's accounting for strategic investments, partnerships with investment components, and related capital transactions, and support mergers and acquisitions when deal volume requires. You will report to the Senior Director, Technical Accounting – M&A and Investments.

As Anthropic continues to scale rapidly and deploy capital into strategic investments, joint ventures, and novel commercial structures, including compute arrangements that carry warrants and other investment features, you will be a key technical resource on classification, consolidation outcomes, fair value, and financial statement impact across the portfolio. You will partner closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, and leadership to ensure that investment economics are accurately reflected under US GAAP and that positions are defensible to external auditors, valuation specialists, and future regulators.

This is a builder role: you'll help stand up and continuously sharpen the portfolio accounting process, controls, and valuation governance expected of a world class finance organization, working alongside the Senior Director as the function takes shape. If you want to own a portfolio end to end — and still be in the room when deals are shaped — we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Execute technical accounting for strategic investments, joint ventures, partnership structures, and related financing/equity instruments from entry through exit
  • Partner with and influence Corporate Development to steer investment structures toward preferred terms and outcomes, reviewing term sheets and deal documents before signing
  • Own entry accounting for each new investment — classification under ASC 321, 323, or 810, VIE/primary-beneficiary analysis, basis differences, and the initial measurement memo
  • Run the quarterly portfolio review — reconsideration events, impairment indicators, observable price changes, and equity method pick-ups — and account for follow-on investments, conversions, down rounds, and exits
  • Own the investment rollforward, its reconciliation to the general ledger, and the portfolio reporting that supports close, FP&A, and leadership, including review of portfolio company financial statements
  • Manage third-party valuation specialists; review fair values of investment

jobs.description:

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Accounting – M&A to join our Finance team at Anthropic. In this role, you will support the company's accounting for mergers, acquisitions, strategic investments, and other complex capital transactions. You will report to the Senior Director, Technical Accounting – M&A

As Anthropic continues to scale rapidly and deploy capital into acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and novel commercial structures, you will be a key technical resource on structuring alternatives, consolidation outcomes, and financial statement impact. You will partner closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, and leadership to ensure that deal economics are accurately reflected under US GAAP and that positions are defensible to external auditors, valuation specialists, and future regulators.

This is a builder role: you'll help operate and continuously sharpen the controls, valuation governance, and close-ready documentation expected of a large accelerated filer, working alongside the Senior Director as the function takes shape. If you thrive on being in the room when deals are shaped — and then making the accounting land cleanly — we want to hear from you.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute technical accounting for business combinations, asset acquisitions, joint ventures, and related financing/equity structures
  • Partner with and influence Corporate Dev to steer deal structures toward preferred terms and outcomes
  • Perform accounting due diligence on prospective transactions, advising Corporate Development and leadership on GAAP, control, and earnings implications before terms are finalized
  • Execute end-to-end purchase accounting — acquirer and acquisition-date identification, consideration measurement (contingent consideration, rollover equity, replacement awards), and recognition/measurement of assets, liabilities, and goodwill
  • Execute post-close integration accounting — conforming accounting policies, system/ledger onboarding, working capital true-ups, earn-out remeasurement, and push-down considerations
  • Assess and monitor consolidation and investment classification for investees and structured arrangements — VIE/primary-beneficiary analysis, reconsideration events, equity method, measurement alternative, and fair value through earnings — and support impairment and observable-price-change reviews
  • Manage third-party valuation specialists; review PPA,

jobs.title: [Palworld Mobile] 개발 PM (3년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • Palworld Mobile은 원작의 오픈월드 경험을 유지하면서도, 언제 어디서나 빠르게 몰입할 수 있는 게임 플레이를 제공하고자 합니다.
  • 모바일에 최적화된 인터페이스와 터치 기반 조작 시스템을 통해 손안에서 펼쳐지는 무한한 모험의 세계를 즐길 수 있도록 설계하려 합니다.
  • 원작의 방대한 오픈월드와 생존, 제작 시스템, 다양한 Pal과 함께하는 즐거움을 유지하면서도, 모바일 환경에 최적화된 플레이로 만들어 나갈 예정입니다.
  • Palworld Mobile에서만 경험할 수 있는 새로운 기능과 콘텐츠로 진일보된 게임 플레이 경험을 선사하고자 합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 우리 조직과 프로젝트의 방향을 이해하고, 전체 개발 일정과 업무를 조율하고 리스크를 관리합니다.
  • 개발 공정을 이해하고, 우리 조직의 요구 사항과 프로젝트의 개선 필요 사항을 기반으로 효율적인 업무 진행이 가능하도록 프로세스를 수립하고 개선하는 업무를 주도합니다.
  • 대내외적으로 원활한 협업을 이끌어 내기 위해 적극적이면서도 긍정적인 자세로 행동하고, 복잡한 이해관계를 이해하고 합리적으로 조율합니다.
  • 효율적으로 업무하고 원활하게 협업하는 조직 문화가 정착할 수 있도록 지속적으로 노력합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 개발 PM 관련 경력 3년 이상이신 분
  • 모바일 프로젝트 개발 초기부터 런칭까지의 경험이 있으신 분
  • Jira / Confluence 구축 및 관리에 대한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 높은 커뮤니케이션 능력으로 대내외 부서와 원활한 의사 소통이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 긍정적인 마인드를 가지고 있으며, 꼼꼼한 업무 처리가 가능하신 분
  • 100명 이상 되는 대규모 개발 조직 & 언리얼 엔진을 사용한 프로젝트에서 개발 PM 역할을 수행하신 분
  • 개발 프로세스 제안 -> 도입 -> 활용 -> 개선까지 경험이 있으신 분
  • Redmine, JIRA, Confluence, Slack, Notion, Trello 등 여러 협업/생산성 도구를 이해하고 효과적으로 사용하시는 분
  • SVN, GIT, Perforce 등 형상 관리툴을 사용한 버전 관리 및 브랜치 운영 그리고 빌드 배포 시스템에 대한 이해도가 있으신 분
  • 기술적 이해도를 바탕으로 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
  • 모바일 게임을 즐겨하시고, 특히 팰월드

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Office of the CCO
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Office of the Chief Commercial Officer is a small team that works directly with our CCO, go-to-market leadership, and company leadership on Anthropic’s highest-priority commercial initiatives. We take on problems that do not sit cleanly inside one team, such as standing up a program that spans Product, Finance, Legal, and Sales, or preparing the material our executives and Board use to make decisions. Our commercial business is growing faster than its operating processes can be built, so a growing share of the job is stepping into gaps and running something important, while making sure other teams are building the capabilities to permanently own.

You will own workstreams end to end. One week that means running the go-to-market side of a pressing situation, from the communications plan for customers and account teams to the daily readout for executives. Another week it means building the analysis behind a resourcing decision or a new program and writing it up for the CCO. This is an internal role. You will report to the CCO’s chief of staff, and you will have an unusually broad view of how the company makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive priority go-to-market initiatives from plan to delivery, removing blockers, escalating early, and connecting the right people across teams at the right time

  • Build the analysis, draft the document or deck, and turn input from many teams into a recommendation executives can act on

  • Prepare content for the CCO and leadership team, including weekly staff meetings, updates to the Office of the CEO, Board materials, and leadership offsites

  • Track the go-to-market organization’s top priorities and keep a current view of status, owners, and risks

  • Act as a bridge between go-to-market and Product, Finance, Legal, Safeguards, and Research, so that what account teams hear from customers reaches product decisions and those decisions reach account teams in a usable form

  • Step in where something important has no clear owner, run it until it has a permanent home, and hand it over cleanly

  • Close out same-day executive requests quickly and to a high standard

  • Have 4+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy and operations, a chief of staff team, or a similarly rigorous environment working with senior executives

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day.   • Interest in Al for content and code generation

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a quality-focused Senior Release Manager to work closely with our producers, programmers, build programmers, and QA teams to oversee the build and release process for the Fortnite Ecosystem. In this position, you will work directly with the brightest technical minds in the business as we build the premier game engine for a multitude of platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers
  • Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products
  • Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases
  • Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release
  • Work closely with QA, Build Programmers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges
  • Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

  • Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience
  • Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement

jobs.title: Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

New hires join Anthropic every week; their first days here shape how they understand our mission and culture, and help to accelerate their time to productivity. We're looking for a Program Manager to own the live delivery of our new hire onboarding program, so that every cohort, whatever its size or timing, gets an experience that is well run, welcoming, and grounded in what makes Anthropic distinctive.

You'll own our San Francisco onboarding program end to end: facilitating sessions, overseeing the operating rhythm behind each cohort, and orchestrating across Recruiting, People Services, Workplace, IT, and the many presenters who bring the program to life. You'll work within our overall onboarding strategy and program design, and your job is to deliver our live onboarding program reliably, week after week, while spotting where the experience can get better and feeding those insights into how the program evolves.

This role suits someone who loves the craft of running a great program: the preparation, the moments in the room, and the systems that make it all repeatable at scale. You'll do well here if you stay calm when plans change, care deeply about the details that shape a first impression, and bring warmth and clarity to a room of people on their first day.

This role requires being in the office at least two days a week – on all programming days and as needed otherwise.

Key responsibilities

  • Own weekly program delivery: Run each onboarding cohort from pre-arrival readiness through program close, so every cohort gets a consistent, high-quality experience

  • Facilitate live sessions: Serve as the primary facilitator and host for every cohort, setting the tone for new hires and keeping the program on time and on message

  • Support presenters and facilitators: Brief and prepare the speakers, panelists, and backup facilitators who deliver program content, so sessions land well regardless of who is in the room; deliver feedback as needed and support content iteration

  • Oversee cross-functional execution: Partner closely with the NHO coordinator to coordinate across Recruiting, People Services, Workplace, IT, and AV, so that start dates, device readiness, rooms, catering, and communications come together each week

  • Set the weekly operating rhythm: Prioritize and sequence program logistics and coordination

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. The team is based in Europe and the US and works daily to create captivating new experiences for our players.

Senior UI Artist

Every season of Monopoly GO! introduces new ways for players to play, explore, and interact. Great UI is what makes those experiences feel intuitive, polished, and rewarding, guiding players through the game while reinforcing the personality and charm that defines every season.

The craft of UI design is evolving just as quickly as the game itself, and we expect our Senior UI Artists to evolve with it. That's because we believe modern creative careers reward those who continuously evolve. AI fluency and the ability to quickly adopt new tools are part of the craft, not optional extras.

If you're motivated by crafting beautiful, intuitive experiences, refining your design practice through new tools and technologies, and seeing your work shape how millions of players experience Monopoly GO!, you'll find no shortage of opportunities here.

What You Will Do

  • Create mockups, pitches, and polished UI assets for Monopoly GO! features, translating flowcharts and wireframes into usable, delightful UI systems.
  • Apply AI-assisted tools and workflows fluently within your UI practice, identifying, refining, and sharing approaches that meaningfully improve quality, iteration, or efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with game designers, UX designers, concept artists, animators, and engineers to keep the player experience consistent and high-quality.
  • Present and advocate for your UI direction to stakeholders, and mentor junior UI artists informally.
  • Be the point of contact for UI questions on your assigned features, keeping production updated on progress.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years practical art/design experience in games, preferably mobile, with 2+ years in a senior-level capacity.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted creative tools and the judgment to identify where they can meaningfully improve your own UI design and production workflows.
  • Track record shipping polished UI systems for mobile titles, collaborating across Design, UX, and Engineering.
  • Expert-level UI/UX and graphic design skills, inc

jobs.description:
Scopely is seeking an experienced a Lead Finance Analyst/Manager to join Product Finance in support of our LIVE Games Portfolio — a group of live-operated, top-grossing mobile games generating meaningful revenue for Scopely. This is a senior, high-visibility role for someone ready to operate as a true finance business partner: owning financial models end-to-end, driving KPI and performance reporting, and initiating the projects that shape how the portfolio is managed.

Based out of our Barcelona office, you will partner directly with General Managers and cross-functional stakeholders across game studios, User Acquisition, Data Science and Finance leadership, Accounting, and central teams. You will be a key voice in portfolio-level decision-making, translating data and models into clear recommendations for senior leadership. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, exhibit the highest personal and professional integrity, and work effectively with supervision while independently managing recurring monthly and quarterly deliverables.

Unlike an entry-level analyst role, this position calls for someone who can operate with a high degree of autonomy — identifying problems, initiating and leading projects, and managing senior stakeholders across the organization with minimal oversight, while still delivering the operational rigor (forecasting, close support, variance analysis) that keeps the portfolio running smoothly

  • Project Initiation: Identify opportunities and lead process improvement and automation projects — forecasting model redesigns, KPI dashboard builds, reporting infrastructure — from scoping through execution.
  • Global Portfolio Exposure: Work across Scopely's live games portfolio from our Barcelona hub, collaborating daily with teams across the US, EMEA, and beyond.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Lead Systems Designer to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day – whether in our work environments alongside talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players around the world daily.

Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market. Our next chapter is bold: we’re evolving the traditional 4X experience in STFC — and we need a bold design leader to shape the content and loops our players engage with on a daily basis.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Designer on STFC, you’ll own the standards, direction, and experiences that define how millions of players experience growth and mastery across our monthly content releases and beyond.

  • Become the design owner and leader behind the feature pipeline, directing designers and UX specialists in crafting compelling experiences for our players
  • Guide teams through the creative process, ensuring they can hit the vision of the game and deliver upon player and product needs with accuracy
  • Get your hands dirty through direct involvement in building and refining novel gameplay experiences focused on resource generation, spending, time gating, and power growth
  • Create systems that foster meaningful player agency and long-term investment
  • Manage and mentor designers in systems and economy design to elevate our standards and craft incredible experiences
  • Shape the design process to ensure the standards of players are met and exceeded
  • Use tools (Excel, Google Sheets) to model economies and progression pacing
  • Collaborate with Experienced, driven and passionate Designers, Product Managers, Analysts, and Engineers to implement features which aim to advance the genre
  • Evaluate performance using data, player feedback, and your own playtest experience
  • Design for scale: plan for long-term content extensibility and system health

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of game design leadership experience
  • Proven experience in F2P systems design and progression modelling
  • 8+ years of experience designing systems or economies for live, F2P games (preferably MMO, 4X, or strategy genres)
  • Confident people manager and mentor, that is able to grow & nurture talent
  • Experience with all aspects of game design discipline: concept, game progression, interface, monetization, and retention
  • A proven track record of delivering features that balance player fun, engage

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

ART

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Principal Al Engineer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Architect and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend engineers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context engineering), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment
  • Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language
  • Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services, and a web front end
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • BS/MS in

jobs.title: Director, IT SOX
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, IT SOX to join the Internal Audit team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a hands-on technical contributor and key executor of our IT SOX compliance program, with deep focus on our IT General Controls, IT Application Controls, and system risk assessments.

This role reports to the Head of IT SOX and is well-suited for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, thrives in a high-pace environment, and enjoys solving problems that don't yet have industry-standard answers. This is a high-impact opportunity to collaborate with first and second lines of defense to help establish a control environment suitable for an AI-first company! You will act as a trusted advisor to Engineering, GRC, Security and Finance teams on the technology controls adapted to a fast growing and rapidly changing organization.

You'll bring technical depth, a bias toward automation, and the ability to partner effectively with both technical teams and external auditors as the organization experiences scaling to public-company standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Advise on the design of a control environment fit for an AI-first company, including controls over highly automated DevOps pipelines and emerging agentic identity models
  • Partner with Engineering, Security, IT, and DevOps teams to assess the design and implementation of scalable and sustainable controls
  • Assess new system implementations and changes
  • Identify automation and tooling opportunities to improve control efficiency and monitoring, and contribute to the development of continuous monitoring capabilities
  • Assist in scoping and planning for annual SOX IT assessments
  • Execute IT SOX testing across IT General Controls and IT Application Controls, including access management, change management, and computer operations
  • Perform system and process risk assessments to identify control gaps and recommend remediation
  • Own control documentation and ensure audit-ready evidence is current and complete
  • Evaluate IT automated controls and support the shift from manual to automated control reliance
  • Scale the IT SOX program as the company grows — rationalizing scope, standardizing testing approaches, and building repeatable processes that keep pace with new systems and entities
  • Guide and direct the day-to-day work of internal team members and co-sourced partners: setting priorities, reviewing workpapers, and ensuring quality and consistency a

  • Ability to explain compensation topics clearly to different audiences in writing and conv

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Consumer Revenue
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for talented Software Engineers to join our Consumer Revenue squads, the teams at the heart of premium experiences at Discord. You’ll be building out a premium Discord for millions of subscribers, focusing on surfaces such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more. Your work will be vital in delivering a high-value premium experience, without compromising the core experience for our free users. You’ll be a key driver in generating the revenue that fuels Discord’s mission.

In this product engineering role, you'll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Design, Marketing, and other functions to create best-in-class consumer experiences. Your work will cover the full breadth of the technical stack, from backend data modeling, through business logic in APIs, to polished, user-facing interfaces. You’ll be supported by infrastructure, platform, and product teams on your mission to build the best premium Discord.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve premium Discord experiences such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more.
  • Own projects end to end by partnering with Product to refine requirements, create technical specs, and work closely with Design to execute and deliver best-in-class user experiences.
  • Work with a team of full-stack engineers to ship new features across Web, Android, and iOS.
  • Lead complex initiatives from conception to completion, thriving in ambiguous environments.
  • Rapidly prototype new features and synthesize insights through experimentation.

What you should have

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience. You’re a key technical contributor to your team and have led sizable projects which have had a big impact on your team’s roadmap.
  • Full-stack proficiency. You are an expert in React/React Native with a solid grasp of Python backend development.
  • Product sense. You maintain a high degree of empathy for your internal and external users, and seek feedback from them about your work. You have an eye for what changes can bring a product from good to great.
  • Ownership mentality. You thrive with autonomy, take initiative to drive projects forward, and are comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Pragmatic approach. You find incremental approaches to solving complex problems, enjoy rapidly prototyping solution

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Talent Acquisition Sourcer to join our Talent Acquisition team in Mexico City on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Our Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding & attracting the best of the best for our business. This team sits globally in the US, UK, Spain, Mexico, China & India and is on a mission to engage with top talent to Inspire Play, Every Day!

What You’ll Do

As a Talent Sourcer, you’re developing diverse strategies and building relationships to find and engage with top talent. Your impact goes beyond sourcing, you’ll shape how we approach the top of the funnel, from how we define, assess and attract great talent, to how we tell Scopely’s story in ways that inspire top talent to join us.

  • EMBRACE THE ADVENTURE: Own and manage volume sourcing for multiple complex searches to identify and engage key technical and non-technical talent at all levels in North America and Europe (when required)
  • CARE DEEPLY: Source prospective candidates and maintain our passive candidate pipeline with high-touch, engaging and frequent communication
  • ITERATE TO GREATNESS: Drive innovative sourcing strategies, collaborate with the global Talent team at Scopely to optimize hiring processes, and use data to uncover opportunities, measure engagement, and deliver market insights
  • PLAY TO WIN: Develop and maintain strong working relationships with hiring managers, Talent Partners, and Coordinators to create partnerships that yield exceptional credibility and results
  • IGNITE PASSION, EARN LOYALTY: Build trust with candidates and provide them with complete, accurate, and inspiring information about Scopely whilst delivering a best-in-class candidate experience

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience operating in a global Sourcing/Talent Research function within the tech or gaming industries
  • Superior relationship building & networking skills, attention to detail and ability to create positive lasting impressions with business partners
  • Flexible and self-motivated; ability to deal with ambiguity and complexity, while executing in an environment of constant change
  • Excellent interviewing skills
  • Demonstrated time management and organisational skills with attention to detail
  • AI fluency, with the ability to responsibly leverage AI tools to improve sourcing quality, candidate research, outreach personalisation, market mapping, and workflow efficiency
  • Strong English language

jobs.title: Economic Mobility Partnerships Manager - Career Pathways
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team exists to ensure AI's benefits reach the people and communities that markets typically leave behind. As our work in Economic Mobility builds momentum, we're hiring a partnerships manager dedicated to career pathways in the AI age.

You'll lead Claude Corps, our $150M flagship early career program — a national fellowship placing 1,000 early-career fellows, paid full-time for a year, with nonprofits serving communities across the U.S. Designed and run with CodePath, you'll own the program's success through its first cohorts and its evolution into replicable workforce infrastructure for the field if the program is impactful for both fellows and nonprofit host organizations.

Beyond Claude Corps, you'll grow our talent developer partnerships — building on momentum like our CodePath partnership that infuses Claude and Claude Code in courses that reach 20,000+ students at community colleges, universities and workforce programs across the country. You will also lead workforce-related deployments on AI Fluency and Claude fluency with national and regional partners, helping workers build the skills to shape their own pathways in the AI transition.

This is program and partnership leadership with real stakes on a global scale. The economic mobility field is early in its AI journey, and the organizations we work with choose Anthropic because of values alignment. You'll earn and keep that trust by delivering measurable results by supporting millions of people and their pathways through our partners by 2027. The role rewards entrepreneurial orchestration: building new programs amid ambiguity, scaling what works, and enabling partners to manage mature programs so you can build what's next.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead Claude Corps end-to-end — cohort launches, host organization pipeline, coordination with CodePath, program measurement, and the open-source playbook
  • Develop and close tier-1 partnerships with talent developers, workforce organizations, and philanthropic and public sector partners — from scoping and structuring through deployment, measurement, and scale
  • Deploy AI Fluency workforce development offerings for states and cities, and drive adoption of AI Fluency and Claude fluency training with national and regional partners
  • Orchestrate across functions — working with Anthropic Academy, Economic Research, Applied

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Sales (London, United Kingdom)

jobs.title: Associate Marketing Manager, Korea
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need:

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Staff: Applied AI, Science & Engineering
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Claude is getting good at research. Given a well-posed problem, it can read the literature, write and run simulations, analyze results, and iterate on a design across physics, materials, chemistry, and engineering. But most of the hardest problems in science and engineering aren't well-posed. They live inside companies and labs with their own data, tools, constraints, and experts, and progress depends on turning all of that into work a model can actually do and check.

Our Applied AI, Science & Engineering team takes Claude to the scientists and engineers working on hard problems in energy, materials, hardware design, and other physical-world fields. We build the tools Claude needs to do real research and engineering work. Mostly that means software: the agent harnesses, integrations, evaluations, and working processes that turn a partner's problem into something Claude can make progress on and validate. We find real-world problems and test what we build through partner engagements, then feed our learnings back to our research and product teams. It's early, and the engineers who join now will shape how Claude gets applied to science and engineering.

This is an engineering role first. You'll spend real time with domain experts, become the person who knows how to get Claude working in their field, and prototype quickly alongside them. Most of your time, though, goes into building and hardening the systems that make that work repeatable, not into writing recommendations or configuring someone else's product. A science or engineering background is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert researchers, turn a fuzzy problem into something concrete and checkable, and ship.

Responsibilities

  • Build the agent harnesses and research loops that let Claude carry a problem from literature review through hypothesis generation, simulation, analysis, and design iteration
  • Connect scientific computing and simulation tools (finite element, CFD, electromagnetic, or molecular modeling codes, for example) so Claude can drive them reliably and at scale

About the team

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

Within Security GRC, Compliance & Audit Programs runs the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework, the single set of controls that the whole program is built on. This role sits in Audit & Assurance and owns the framework and the assurance view across every control domain.

About the role

As part of the Security Audit & Controls team, you will own the CCF across every control domain, from access and change management to logging, encryption, and people controls: which controls we have, what each one says, how each maps to the frameworks and commitments we hold, and whether each one is actually working. You'll work with control owners and GRC Partners to draft and validate control descriptions and activities that describe reality rather than policy intent, build the monitoring that shows operating effectiveness continuously instead of once a year, and drive what monitoring finds to closure with control owners.

Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: drafting and mapping controls, testing evidence, and monitoring control health, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a control set that is accurate, tested, and trusted by auditors and engineers alike.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Secure Frameworks is the team in Anthropic's Security Engineering org that builds shared security libraries and frameworks the rest of the company builds on. We collaborate closely with teams and leaders across Anthropic to own critical security foundations, including workload identity and authorization, cryptographic frameworks, and the centralized access proxy that secures traffic to internal applications.

Our mission is to make the secure thing easy and the easy thing secure by helping Anthropic engineers get secure behaviour by default and preventing entire classes of vulnerabilities through careful design. We own what we ship, help customers adopt better security practices and at times we work embedded directly in research, infrastructure or product teams.

About the role

You will design, build and run security foundations used across Anthropic's fleet, from threat model through production, on-call and adoption. Much of the work is greenfield: our infrastructure is growing quickly and the timelines are compressed, so you will help define the architecture rather than inherit it. Depending on your strengths you will focus on one or two of the areas below and contribute across the rest.

  • Build critical security foundations including cryptographic frameworks, mTLS infrastructure, secure serialization, and authorization systems, designed to prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities
  • Partner with product, research, infrastructure, and other security teams to ensure frameworks integrate smoothly with lower-layer security controls
  • Scope, design and build security services and libraries end-to-end, maintain them in production, and drive through ambiguous technical problems with minimal oversight
  • Build and operate the zero-trust access gateway that fronts Anthropic's internal services
  • Design and roll out authorization frameworks so services enforce least privilege consistently instead of each inventing its own access controls
  • Own cryptographic frameworks and libraries
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to hiring, and grow security engineering culture across Anthropic

Minimum qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building security-relevant systems in production, including leading complex initiatives independently
  • Strong programming skills in Go, Rust or Python
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization systems: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWTs, service-to-service auth, policy-b

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function, using automation, quantitative risk and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The risks we assess span Anthropic's full security landscape, so the team needs breadth across domains and the judgment to go deep wherever a decision demands it.   • Shape the analysis and narrative behind leadership risk reviews, and help define risk appetite and the risk metrics the organization should measure and why

  • Use AI and automation to scale risk analysis, and own the calibration and quality review that keep the outputs

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

This role sits in Compliance & Audit Programs and works one regime family, US public sector, from requirements through authorization and ongoing compliance, working alongside the public sector engineering pods rather than downstream of them.

About the role

You'll help drive the compliance programs that keep Anthropic's US government authorizations current: federal civilian (FedRAMP, including FedRAMP 20x for Claude Enterprise), Department of War (DoD impact levels, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171), and state and local (StateRAMP, TX-RAMP and agency requirements). You'll own the recurring cycles those authorizations run on (continuous monitoring, POA&M, annual assessments, significant changes), help build new authorizations as we add them, and keep every frontier model's authorizations current.

You'll turn government requirements into specific, testable requirements that engineering teams build against, review the evidence that comes back, and say so when a launch is not ready for a government boundary. You'll map US government requirements onto our Common Control Framework so the public sector view and the integrated audit view of the same control stay one framework. Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: mapping, evidence collection and reporting, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role, working closely with a peer on US public sector compliance, for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a government authorization that holds up as the product changes underneath it.
